```yaml
---
id: vuln-url-to-png-e4eaeca6
languages:
  - typescript
message: Detected usage of vulnerable function handleExtractQueryParamsMiddleware
severity: ERROR
metadata:
  cve: CVE-2024-39918
  cwe: CWE-22
pattern: |
  $JSX: JSXClosingElement[
    name = "$JSXIdentifier[value =~ /^handleExtractQueryParamsMiddleware$/]"
    attributes = [
      $JSXAttribute[
        name = "$JSXIdentifier[value =~ /^encryptionService$/]"
        value = null
      ]
    ]
  ]
```
This Semgrep rule will detect the usage of the vulnerable function `handleExtractQueryParamsMiddleware` with `encryptionService` parameter set to `null`. It uses the Semgrep JSX pattern syntax to match JSX elements with specific attributes.
